Phylogenetic analysis of the TTRAYs and their closest relatives, β′-COP and α-COP (Figure 4—figure supplement 9), showed that the paralogues are due to ancient duplications in the TSET and COPI families respectively, which occurred prior to the divergence of the LECA.
